title: This Whale Has 1,000 Times More Cells and Doesn't Get More Cancer
subject: bowhead whale

scenes.text: This whale has a thousand times more cells than many animals. Why isn't it full of cancer?
More cells means more chances for one to go wrong. Yet bowhead whales show no higher cancer risk than smaller animals.
They also live about two hundred years. One whale caught in 2007 still carried an 1890s harpoon point.
Scientists sequenced its genome and found extra copies of genes linked to DNA repair and cell growth.
Those genes may be what keeps its cells in check, though that idea is still a hypothesis.
So the longest-living mammal may hold a cancer secret. Scientists are still trying to read it.

description:
Bowhead whales have over a thousand times more cells than many animals, yet they don't get more cancer.
They can live about 200 years, and their genes for DNA repair may be part of the answer.
Which animal should we cover next?
